title: Published Annual Percentage Yields for the Personal Checking Tiers
content:
Three of the six Personal Checking tiers are interest-bearing; the other three are not. For an interest-bearing tier the published schedule is a set of balance bands, each band identified by the balance in United States dollars at which it begins and carrying one annual percentage yield expressed in percent.

| Tier | Tier pays interest |
|---|---|
| Access Checking | no |
| Student Checking | no |
| Everyday Checking | no |
| Interest Checking | yes |
| Premier Checking | yes |
| Private Client Checking | yes |

Access Checking, Student Checking and Everyday Checking publish a single band beginning at 0.00 at a yield of 0.00 percent. The three interest-bearing tiers publish these bands:

| Tier | Band floor (USD) | Annual percentage yield (percent) |
|---|---|---|
| Interest Checking | 0.00 | 0.01 |
| Interest Checking | 10000.00 | 0.02 |
| Interest Checking | 25000.00 | 0.05 |
| Interest Checking | 100000.00 | 0.10 |
| Premier Checking | 0.00 | 0.02 |
| Premier Checking | 10000.00 | 0.05 |
| Premier Checking | 25000.00 | 0.10 |
| Premier Checking | 100000.00 | 0.15 |
| Private Client Checking | 0.00 | 0.05 |
| Private Client Checking | 25000.00 | 0.15 |
| Private Client Checking | 100000.00 | 0.25 |
| Private Client Checking | 250000.00 | 0.35 |

The bands of a tier are read by their floors: a band applies from the balance named as its floor upward, until the floor of the next band above it. Private Client Checking publishes no band at 10000.00, so its opening band runs from 0.00 up to 25000.00.
